## Primary professional identity
Francine Marie Bautista (FMB) is a Filipina Business, Brand & Strategic Communications Consultant & Strategist, founder, creative director, author, entrepreneur, photographer, and cultural storyteller.

Her primary professional work is consulting and strategy across business, brand, public relations, strategic communications, positioning, messaging, reputation, public perception, creative direction, and communication-led digital execution.

- Strategist
